# Vishweshwara Sanskrit

> Vishweshwara Sanskrit is a traditional online Gurukula for Sanskrit, the Vedas and the Bhagavad Gita, led by Acharya Vishweshwara N M (Bangalore, Karnataka, India). Classes are live and online for students worldwide, with a focus on authentic pronunciation, grammar, Indian culture and values.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/): Overview of the Gurukula and its teaching approach
- [About the Acharya](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/about): Background, training and lineage of Acharya Vishweshwara
- [Teachings](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/teachings): Sanskrit, Bhagavad Gita and Krishna Yajurveda programmes
- [Samskrita Foundation Program, Cohort 2026](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/cohort-november-2026/): Live online Sanskrit for children aged 8 to 14
- [Begin your journey](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/begin): Enquiry and enrolment
- [Testimonials](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/testimonials): Student and parent feedback
- [Guru Dakshina](https://vishweshwarasanskrit.com/dakshina): Support the Gurukula

## Facts
- Teacher: Acharya Vishweshwara N M, trained for 7+ years in the traditional Gurukula system; M.A. in Sanskrit
- Subjects: Sanskrit language, Bhagavad Gita, Krishna Yajurveda, Vedanta, Upanishads, Shankara Bhashya
- Format: live online classes, small batches
- Location: Bangalore, India; students from India, USA, Australia, UAE and other countries
- Contact: namaste@vishweshwarasanskrit.com
